verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a payments platform with a merchant-facing Customer Area, so the axis applies. The pack documents only an MCP server that lets developers use natural language through their own external LLM client. That is a developer building block, not an assistant inside the product, so it earns no credit. No evidence shows an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
